# Study area / Área de estudio {#sec-study-area}

## English

The Río Buritaca drains the northern slope of the Sierra Nevada de Santa Marta toward the Caribbean coast of Colombia. The river mouth used as the outlet of the delineation is at 11.2631° N, 73.7681° W.
